BETA Close X Currys Plc has purchased and cancelled a total of 1,783,432 ordinary shares between September 8 and September 14, 2026, as part of its share buy-back program. The average price paid per share during this period was approximately 150.00 pence. Following these transactions, the total number of ordinary shares in issue for Currys Plc is now 1,081,063,684, with no shares held in treasury. This figure serves as the denominator for shareholders calculating their notification obligations under the FCA's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules.
